test_Buffer_append: test the Buffer class by appending transitions and verifying the buffer becomes full
test_Buffer_drain: test the Buffer drain method to retrieve a trajectory with observations and rewards
test_Buffer_empty: test the Buffer empty method after draining to confirm the buffer is empty
test_Buffer_full: test the Buffer full method after appending max sequence length transitions
test_Buffer_partial_trajectory: test the Buffer by appending a single transition and draining a partial trajectory
